#batch_size: decided: a step batch of 128 sequences (batch_size x grad_accum); the critical batch is 93-129 sequences after 1.3B tokens and grows; keep it for the whole study. #fsdp_size: decided 2026-10-18: FSDP over the 8 GPUs of a node; on one node the 1-D mesh, on more nodes a dp x fsdp 8 mesh (FSDP inside each node, data parallel across)
#keep_checkpoints: 0 = all (15 GB each); prune by hand to every 10000th step, the newest and the branch point
